description.value: The Savoy Pub is a neighbourhood pub on East Hastings Street in Vancouver, known for its community-oriented vibe with regular events including karaoke, free pool, and open mic nights. It also operates off-sales, allowing customers to purchase packaged alcohol to go. A touring cyclist passing through the Downtown Eastside would find a no-frills local bar with an active events calendar.
